composing_text: 9th Infantry Regiment; 23rd Infantry Regiment; 38th Infantry Regiment
current_activity: landing at Omaha Beach and entering the line
notes: Landed at Omaha 7 June and entered line under V Corps.

current_activity: advancing to objectives west and south of Forêt de Cerisy
notes: With the 352nd Division withdrawn, marched to objectives west and south of the Foret de Cerisy on 10 June.

current_activity: advancing south of the Elle River
notes: 38th Infantry, with heavy artillery support (>6,500 rounds), advanced about two miles south of the Elle on 13 June.

current_activity: division command post at Les Rairies
notes: CMH ETO-OB lists the command post at Les Rairies, Calvados on this date.
CMH ETO-OB lists the command post at Maisoncelles-la-Jourdan, Calvados on this date.

CMH ETO-OB assignment table entry dated 18 August 1944. Location is the nearest listed CP at Ploudaniel, Finistere (CMH ETO-OB), 1 days after the row date; the division position on the day is not stated.

current_activity: attacking Brest on the left of the VIII Corps line
notes: Breakout-30 p641: 2nd Division on the left of the three-division attack on Brest, afternoon of 25 August.

current_activity: accepting the surrender of eastern Brest at President Wilson Square
notes: Breakout-30 p650: Colonel Pietzonka of the 7th Parachute Regiment surrendered the eastern portion of the city to the 2nd Division on 18 September.

current_activity: division command post at St Vith
notes: CMH ETO-OB lists the command post at St Vith, Liege on this date.

current_activity: fights through Krinkelt-Rocherath and into the Monschau Forest to reach Wahlerscheid from the south
notes: Event date: 1 February 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 3 p. 66: the 2d Division was fighting its way through Krinkelt-Rocherath and then moving into the Monschau Forest to reach Wahlerscheid from the south; as night came on 1 February both it and the 9th Division were ready to file past Wahlerscheid). Event definition: the division attacks with the 9th toward Wahlerscheid; the source places it at the villages and in the forest. Relationship: V Corps unspecified_subordination (from 11 Dec 44, CMH table); First Army assigned (from 22 Oct 44, CMH table); 12th Army Group assigned (from 1 Aug 44, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. The earlier unspecified_subordination relation to VIII Corps (CR0211) is closed at 10 December 1944 (inferred_from_next_claim); see the Review note on it. The earlier assigned relation to Ninth Army (CR0212) is closed at 21 October 1944 (inferred_from_next_claim); see the Review note on it. Location: Rocherath-Krinkelt, where the division was fighting during the day. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap Nominatim (Rocherath-Krinkelt, Liège). Event support: moderate (single Green Book passage). Location support: low (the position of the main body is not given).
